race.comment: HAVE A CRACK (6) was heavily backed and won well fresh before dropping to 1000m last start where he closed well from beyond midfield. Better suited out to 1200m third-up and Nottle's claim comes in handy. Will sit back and launch a strong attack late in the race. SPICY THANG (10) was sound fresh before tackling the Jungle Mist last start where she was just outclassed. Back to this level suits and the visors go on for the first time today. Drawn sticky, but a much better effort is on the cards. OURGIRLCANRUN (4) bounced back with a dominant win last start at an odds-on quote, kicking away from the front to win comfortably. She has the speed to offset the wide alley and she's a third-up winner previously. Can repeat the dose. NICCIANA (9) is third-up today and back to 1200m. She'll get back from the barrier but can be closing strongly with a solid tempo expected. MAGICAL SEQUENCE (5) was sound in the Batavia first-up and can build on that performance.
